# Nowra Skip Bins

> Skip bin hire in Nowra & the Shoalhaven: size guide, what goes in a skip, council rules and typical prices. Free quote from a local operator.

Nowra Skip Bins (nowraskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Nowra, City of Shoalhaven (NSW), including North Nowra, South Nowra, West Nowra, Bomaderry, Worrigee, Cambewarra, Terara, Berry, Shoalhaven Heads, Greenwell Point, Culburra Beach, Callala Bay, Huskisson, Vincentia, Ulladulla, St Georges Basin, Sanctuary Point, Basin View, Erowal Bay, Sussex Inlet
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: see "Quick answers" on the homepage for published ranges and their dates; otherwise a local operator quotes

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Nowra Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Nowra and nearby areas, including North Nowra, South Nowra, West Nowra, Bomaderry, Worrigee, Cambewarra, Terara, Berry, Shoalhaven Heads, Greenwell Point, Culburra Beach, Callala Bay, Huskisson, Vincentia, Ulladulla, St Georges Basin, Sanctuary Point, Basin View, Erowal Bay, Sussex Inlet. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need council approval. On a road, footpath or nature strip, Shoalhaven City Council's Local Approvals Policy lists placing a waste container in a public place as needing section 68 approval. Call council on 1300 293 111 before you book. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. More than 10 m² of bonded asbestos must be removed by a licensed removalist in NSW.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Prices published online for the Nowra area, checked 23 Oct 2026, started from about $330–$373 for a 2 m³ skip and about $990 for a 12 m³ skip ("from" prices on local and national hire sites). These aren't our prices or a quote. Size, waste type, weight, hire length and delivery distance all change the price, and a local operator will quote for your job.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Nowra Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
